text.title: 第一张桌上的叶片
text.situation:
乔带着保护区的笔记来到这里。第一张桌上，生物学家把一片保存的叶子放在同种植物的画旁。标本小得能放在卡片上，标签却记录了采集地点。桌后展牌介绍生物学，即研究生命的学科。旁边的进化图比较相关植物在许多世代中的变化。玛雅寻找每幅画的日期，不想把世代变化误当作叶子在一个下午中的变化。

乔：这片叶子是在这里采的吗？
生物学家：不是，标签写着地点。
玛雅：图涵盖了几个世代吗？
生物学家：是的，标本和图回答不同的问题。

paragraphs.en: Jo arrived with the notebook from the reserve. On the first table, a biologist had placed a preserved leaf beside a drawing of the same plant. The specimen was small enough to fit on a card, but its label showed where it had been collected. A board behind the table introduced biology, the study of living things. Beside it, an evolutionary diagram compared related plants over many generations. Maya looked for the date of each drawing. She did not want to mistake a change across generations for a leaf changing during one afternoon.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Did someone collect this leaf here?
Biologist: No. Its label gives the location.
Maya: And the diagram covers several generations?
Biologist: Yes. The specimen and the diagram answer different questions.
